stories.headline: Council approves first phase of the northern rail extension
stories.summary: Councillors voted 31 to 12 for phase one of the commuter line. Construction tenders open in January.

stories.headline: Ward offices to open on Saturdays from December
stories.summary: Residents who work on weekdays can get permits and letters on Saturday mornings.

stories.headline: Residents split over the northern line's route
stories.summary: Riverside wants a station near the market. Kora wants one beside the clinic.

stories.headline: Council publishes the northern rail extension proposal
stories.summary: The proposal splits the line into two phases. Phase one has four stations.

stories.headline: Kora Junction bridge reopens to lorries
stories.summary: After eight months of repairs, the bridge takes lorries up to 20 tonnes again.
